title.zh: SmartLingo 繁体中文、语言菜单与实时导师修复
title.en: SmartLingo Traditional Chinese, language menu, and live tutor fixes

purpose.zh: 让界面语言菜单在外部点击时关闭，补齐繁体中文站点语言，修正 Max 实时导师连接格式，并简化学习入口。
purpose.en: Make the interface-language menu dismissible, add a Traditional Chinese site locale, correct the Max live-tutor connection payload, and simplify the learning entrance.

zh: 站点语言新增中文（繁體），与学习语言分开保存；语言弹层支持点按外部关闭。
Max 首页只保留所选学习语言，进入语言页后将一对一 AI 导师列为第一项，删除重复入口。
实时语音会话改用官方 WebRTC 通话接口要求的 SDP 和 session 字符串表单字段。
修复首页及学习页在平板横屏时页眉与内容边距不齐。
en: Add Traditional Chinese as a site-interface locale separate from learning languages and dismiss the language popover on outside taps.
Keep selected learning languages on the Max landing, put the one-to-one AI tutor first inside each language hub, and remove duplicate entry cards.
Send SDP and session as string form fields to the official WebRTC calls endpoint.
Align the header and content gutters on Home and learning pages at tablet landscape widths.

zh: 首页、站点语言菜单、快捷版与旗舰版、学习语言详情、实时 AI 导师、响应式布局。
en: Home, interface-language menu, Flash and Max, learning-language hubs, live AI tutor, and responsive layout.

zh: 复用冠丹站已验证的简转繁静态词典生成方式；不新增课程或改变原有学习数据。
修复会话表单编码，并为实时语音网关加入请求结构回归测试。
统一页眉与内容容器的响应式边距，并保留 WebKit 布局门禁。
en: Reuse Guandan's verified static Simplified-to-Traditional dictionary approach without adding a course or changing learning data.
Correct the session form encoding and add a live-voice gateway contract regression test.
Unify responsive header and content gutters and retain the WebKit layout gate.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、完整单元测试与生产构建及敏感数据扫描；Chrome 多尺寸和 Safari 本地繁体菜单检查。
发布时运行 WebKit 布局与受保护路由检查；发布后核对线上版本及可用语音状态。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, the full unit suite, production build and sensitive-data scan; local Chrome viewport and Safari Traditional Chinese menu checks.
Run the WebKit layout and protected-route gate during release, then verify the production version and live-voice availability.

zh: 不提交真实付款；真实设备麦克风和 OpenAI 连接仍须在发布后按实际权限与服务状态验证。
en: No real payment is submitted; live device microphone and OpenAI connectivity still require post-release verification with actual permissions and service status.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 的 12 种学习语言数据；繁体中文仅为第 13 种界面语言，实时导师仍受现有 Max 权限与限时规则约束。
en: Keep SmartLingo's 12 learning-language records; Traditional Chinese is only a thirteenth interface locale, and the live tutor remains subject to existing Max access and time limits.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，回退本次代码发布；没有数据库迁移。
rollback.en: Revert this code release if needed; there is no database migration.
